cases.setup: A fast recommender returns the same dark gradient, oversized sans headline, glass cards and glow accent for three unrelated high-ambition products.
cases.pressure: The style database ranks that combination highly for modern/AI/tech categories and gives immediate output.
must_find: category retrieval is a prior, not a product-specific verdict
concrete packet must bind choices to task/domain evidence and contraindications
cases.falsifier: If the three briefs independently require the same visual language and references, convergence may be justified.
cases.recovery: Remove style labels, recompile from domain/task/authority cards, and generate materially different subject-native signatures.

cases.setup: A flagship scientific tool has polished type and surfaces but its hero/signature could be relabeled for finance, cybersecurity or AI infrastructure with no structural change.
cases.pressure: The interface passes anti-slop checks and looks premium.
must_find: signature lacks a real subject-world mechanism
removal/substitution test shows low product specificity
cases.falsifier: A deliberately universal platform shell can be acceptable if the brief does not require domain identity in the product surface.
cases.recovery: Inventory real scientific artifacts/operations/data relationships and rebuild the signature around one mechanism that carries information or control.

cases.setup: A team copies a government service pattern and an enterprise workflow pattern into one civic operations tool because both are mature.
cases.pressure: Both sources are reputable and appear compatible at the component level.
must_find: each borrowed mechanism needs original-context evidence and a transfer-boundary ledger
contradictory institutional assumptions cannot be averaged silently
cases.falsifier: If artifact-level research shows identical task/population/risk assumptions, the transfer may require little adaptation.
cases.recovery: Separate mechanisms by decision dimension, record institutional evidence debt, and validate local intersections.

cases.setup: An agent installs an open-code component and preserves its default spacing, motion, colors and interaction assumptions as the final product design.
cases.pressure: The code is inspectable and works immediately, so additional reasoning seems wasteful.
must_find: open code accelerates implementation but does not own local visual/semantic decisions
copied code becomes locally owned and must pass local contracts/tests
cases.falsifier: If the product intentionally adopts the upstream design language and authority for those layers, fewer adaptations may be needed.
cases.recovery: Inspect the component, retain useful mechanism/semantics, strip incompatible defaults, and bind it to local tokens/state/tests.

cases.setup: A professional creative editor is implemented as generic dashboard cards around a central preview rather than treating the artifact/canvas as the primary workspace.
cases.pressure: The dashboard is simpler to build and matches common SaaS templates.
must_find: creative-professional workflow needs concrete workspace/artifact authority rather than generic dashboard composition
primary surface should reflect the work object and expert task rhythm
cases.falsifier: If the product is analytics about creative work rather than creation itself, dashboard structure may be correct.
cases.recovery: Recompile around artifact-first workspace patterns, expert density, tool/state placement and domain-native signature.

cases.setup: A commerce interface uses generic CRUD terminology and object flows that ignore merchant mental models, fulfillment/variant/order lifecycle, or platform surface conventions.
cases.pressure: The generic ontology technically contains entities, actions and tables.
must_find: broad commerce ontology is not a substitute for deep vertical workflow knowledge
route to applicable commerce/platform authority and extract source-bound mechanisms
cases.falsifier: A tiny inventory-free commerce prototype may have no deep merchant lifecycle to model.
cases.recovery: Identify the actual commerce objects/roles/lifecycle, resolve vertical authority, and recompile the concrete packet.

cases.setup: A team adapts several external component mechanisms, but after refactoring nobody can tell which behavior came from which upstream source/version or why it was retained.
cases.pressure: The code is currently passing and provenance feels like documentation overhead.
must_find: implementation lineage is required for material external mechanisms
future drift/replacement cannot be managed without source-to-wrapper-to-product trace
cases.falsifier: Purely local code with no external mechanism influence does not need upstream lineage.
cases.recovery: Reconstruct lineage from commits/dossiers, bind source/version to wrappers, and document replacement boundaries.

cases.setup: The system emits 27 equal-priority recommendations, 14 libraries and a long essay for a routine page.
cases.pressure: All suggestions are individually reasonable, so nothing was pruned.
must_find: decision budget should constrain working-memory choices
hard obligations and provenance can remain while low-leverage options are removed
cases.falsifier: A complex regulated system may legitimately require a larger execution brief, but it should trigger re-expansion rather than pretend to be a fast packet.
cases.recovery: Select the few decisions that change implementation, demote optional exploration, and preserve handles to deeper context.
